confirm.mismatch: The name does not match yet.
confirm.failed: The action could not be completed. Nothing was changed. Try again.

server_error.title: Something went wrong on our side.
server_error.reason: The server could not complete the request.
server_error.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, give your administrator the request ID below.

network_error.title: Can't reach Cenacle.
network_error.reason: Your device may be offline, or the server cannot be reached.
network_error.action: Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: You don't have permission to do this.
forbidden.reason: Your role in this workspace does not allow this action.
forbidden.action: Ask a workspace admin for access.

not_found.title: This page doesn't exist.
not_found.reason: It may have been moved or deleted.
not_found.action: Check the address or go back.

rate_limited.title: You're going a little fast.
rate_limited.reason: Too many requests were sent in a short time.

session_expired.title: Your session has ended.
session_expired.reason: For your security, you were signed out.
session_expired.action: Sign in again. Your drafts and place are kept.

service_unavailable.title: Cenacle is temporarily unavailable.
service_unavailable.reason: The service is starting up or under maintenance.
